protocol.pooling_limitation: Physical archives have whole-syllable timings, not reviewed nucleus/coda phone spans. Uniformly pool the existing whole syllable as a proxy. Same frozen weights/layer/context; this is an exploratory representation mismatch, not matched-span evaluation.
